    # Locate the 1-filled rectangular canvas and apply anti-diagonal reflection.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    h, w = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    out = [[1]*h for _ in range(w)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v = grid[r0+r][c0+c]
            if v != 1:
                out[w-1-c][h-1-r] = v
    return out
